record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, untie real-item input and output embedding tables while preserving width 64 and the current row normalization and radius. Initialize the output table by copying the initial real-item input rows, then train both jointly within the same BERT4Rec network. Separate context and prediction representations may ease conflicting gradients without the radius increase that previously regressed. Keep dot-product scoring, history, topology, loss and optimizer fixed; update checkpoint loading and the predictor writer consistently.

category_rationales.rationale: Untie context and prediction embeddings across all four category models while retaining width, row normalization and radius. Copy initial real-item input rows into the output table, then train both jointly. This may reduce conflicting embedding gradients. The generated predictor imports the updated model class and strictly loads its checkpoint, preserving architecture consistency.
